var values = [52, 17, 38, 9, 61, 38, 24, 45], total = 0
for i in 1..<values.count {
    let value = values[i]
    var j = i - 1, shifts = 0
    while j >= 0 && values[j] > value {
        values[j + 1] = values[j]
        j -= 1
        shifts += 1
    }
    values[j + 1] = value
    total += shifts
    print("i=\(i) shifts=\(shifts): \(values.map(String.init).joined(separator: " "))")
}
print("total shifts: \(total)")
